scope.notes: Assume shrouded machine, no need to model tip gap

stacking.notes: This is an important aspect. You can proceed with it in the first implementation, but you should discuss in a note the pros/cons of the different options an dthe implementation complexity.

thickness.notes: You can implement what oyu think is more suitable, but please do not use complex iterative calculations in the blade parametrization. I want a clean explicit once-through parametrization if possilbe

edge_shape.notes: We do not need cutoff shapes for the parametrization trailing edge. Is is fine to have both rounded

details.thesis_location: Actually, I prefer that you work in a directory in turbodash/development/impeller. In this directory you can make a compy of a yaml configuration file with the geometry inputs for the parametrization obtained from the output file of the master thesis meanline code. I think this can work well
details.clearance_source: Use the selected case; confirm the distance direction before interpreting eps_a.
details.extra_outputs: Please, also prepare a markdown  document with the next steps of things that should be impleented, or things that should be imporved based on the outcomes of what you implemented.

brief.scope: Complete impeller geometry first; meshing deferred.
brief.reuse: Reuse maintained Turbodash, TurboMoC and nurbspy implementations.
brief.reversibility: One physical impeller shared by compressor and turbine operation.
brief.app_gate: Geometry and export validation; no mesh prerequisite.
